__path.description: Workspace-relative path of the artifact file, injected by the orchestration harness (not authored in frontmatter).

__kind.description: Artifact-kind discriminator injected by the harness; must equal x-artifact.kind.

__artifact_id.description: Stable artifact id injected by the harness, derived from the file and frontmatter.

__frontmatter_present.description: Harness assertion that YAML frontmatter was found and parsed; always true for a valid artifact.

__sections.description: Artifact body sections keyed by their `## ` heading — one property per template section; the value is the raw Markdown under that heading. Authored artifacts may add or omit sections, so this is advisory (additionalProperties is permitted) and no section is individually required.

Enabler intent.description: Describe the runway capability, engineering support, or risk reduction this Feature delivers.

Acceptance criteria.description: Use one flat bullet per criterion, labeled `AC1`, `AC2`, `AC3`

Enablement hypothesis.description: Explain what future delivery, operability, compliance, or architectural decision this Feature makes possible, safer, or cheaper.

NFR applicability / trace.description: List the canonical product NFRs from `products/<product-slug>/nfr-list.md` that apply to this Feature, plus any Feature-specific tightening or derived verification notes. Do not redefine the product's canonical NFR set here. A missing NFR is a runway concern, not Feature AC.

Work-item relations.description: Use typed relations to make the enabler's program effect explicit.

Architecture decision inventory.description: If `structurant: true`, point to the committed architecture inventory artifact that tracks the Feature's decision units, their coverage state, linked ADRs, waivers, and enabler follow-up. If `structurant: false`, set `architectureInventory: null` and omit this section.

Open items.description: The human-readable companion to the `openItems:` frontmatter ledger (the [open-item ledger](../../orchestrator/SKILL.md#open-item-ledger)) — this enabler Feature's **clarifications** (proactive unknowns surfaced by the CE Discovery turn) and **challenges** (reactive findings from peer revi...

Story breakdown (filled in step 6 by PO).description: `Story breakdown (filled in step 6 by PO)` section of the artifact body.

__body.description: Raw Markdown body of the artifact (everything after the frontmatter), injected by the harness.

status.description: funnel | refined | arch-pending | ready | committed | in-progress | done | blocked | not-needed (the step decided no enabler is needed; the file records that decision and leaves the flow)

workItemRelations.description: Typed work-item relations (dependsOn / enables / relatedTo / supersedes).

wsjf.description: Weighted Shortest Job First scoring block.

openItems.description: clarification + challenge ledger — see orchestrator "Open-item ledger". Each entry: { id, kind, raised_by, owner, blocking, status, … }; kind: clarification | challenge. status: open | resolved | withdrawn. A blocking+open entry HALTS the ★ Feature/Architecture Gate.

cost.description: Token-cost accounting block (see the cost definition).

github.description: GitHub Projects sync envelope, filled by portfolio/_sync (null when authoring).

parentEpic.description: Parent Epic id this Feature realizes (null if unparented).

epicRationale.description: Why this Feature belongs to its parent Epic.

structurant.description: Whether this Feature is structurant (architecturally significant; triggers an ADR and the Architecture Gate).

architectureInventory.description: required when structurant=true; path to architecture/decision-inventory-F-N-*.md

adrs.description: ADR ids this artifact depends on.

pi.description: Program Increment number this artifact is associated with.

owner.description: Accountable owner role/hat for this artifact.

sources.description: Derivation provenance (narrowed subtype of the base contract's sources): refs to the upstream artifact(s) this feature-enabler was built from. Allowed source kinds: epic-enabler, architecture-runway.

stepOutcomes.description: Step outcome record — one entry per step that committed this artifact (see the stepOutcomes definition).

tokensIn.description: NET-NEW prompt tokens = sum(inputTokens - cachedTokens) of this item's dispatches.

tokensOut.description: Sum of outputTokens of those dispatches.

tokensCached.description: Sum of cachedTokens (re-sent context); excluded from tokensSelf, kept for billed-cost reconstruction.

tokensSelf.description: tokensIn + tokensOut - the item's own net cost.

tokensRolled.description: tokensSelf plus the rolled cost of child items - the item's end-to-end cost.

dispatches.description: Number of subagent dispatches counted into tokensSelf (not llm_request turns).

source.description: Provenance of the cost figures: measured, estimated, or mixed.

committed.description: YYYY-MM-DD the one-time cost snapshot was written; immutable after (null until committed).

githubSync.description: GitHub Projects sync envelope; filled by portfolio/_sync, null when authoring.

issueNumber.description: GitHub issue number; filled by portfolio/_sync, null when authoring.

issueNodeId.description: GitHub issue node id; filled by portfolio/_sync, null when authoring.

projectItemId.description: GitHub Projects item id; filled by portfolio/_sync, null when authoring.

openItems.description: Clarification + challenge ledger entries (each an object: id, kind, raised_by, owner, blocking, status, ...).

stepOutcomes.description: Step outcome record. Every workflow step that commits this artifact appends exactly one entry, so the artifact itself carries the step's decision — including `confirmed`, `no-change` and `none` — and the agent's reply stays indicative.

step.description: `<workflow-slug>/<step-slug>` of the step that appended this entry.

outcome.description: written (created) | revised (content changed) | confirmed (reviewed, still valid) | no-change (out of scope on this run) | none (not needed; the artifact records that decision)

note.description: One line: what the step decided and why.

friction.description: Optional. Workflow friction the step's actor observed (raw input, never a fix). Only `@release-train-engineer` turns it into a pain point, in an `improvement-backlog` workflow step.

dependsOn.description: Hard prerequisite artifact ids that must advance or land before this item.

enables.description: Artifact ids this item intentionally makes possible or materially easier.

relatedTo.description: Non-gating semantic or strategic links; never use as a hidden dependency list.

supersedes.description: Artifact ids intentionally replaced by this item.

wsjf.description: Weighted Shortest Job First scoring block used to rank the backlog.

userBusinessValue.description: Relative user/business value of the work item.

timeCriticality.description: How time-sensitive the value is (it decays if delayed).

jobSize.description: Relative size/effort of the job (the WSJF denominator).

score.description: Computed WSJF score = (userBusinessValue + timeCriticality + riskReduction) / jobSize.
